sources.title: Alessandro Portelli interviewed by Paulo Álvarez Bravo, “La historia oral es un arte de la escucha” (2017).
sources.citation: Paulo Álvarez Bravo, interview with Alessandro Portelli, “La historia oral es un arte de la escucha,” Kamchatka 9(July 2017): 543–552. doi:10.7203/KAM.9.10561. Interview conducted in Santiago de Chile on 4 December 2015.

verification.note: Fresh selected Spanish primary interview pp 544–547; printed 546 visually collated against actual institutional-repository PDF, including speaker labels, Gramsci use and Bosio/narrator distinctions. Title page 543 and n 1,p 544 distinguish interview and publication dates. Repository download succeeded locally; web extraction sometimes returned an access-denied page, so that page is not treated as a PDF witness. No original-language recording or Gramsci book read; no translator is identified in the consulted publication.

sources.title: Joan Sangster, “Oral History and Working Class History: A Rewarding Alliance” (2013).
sources.citation: Joan Sangster, “Oral History and Working Class History: A Rewarding Alliance,” Oral History Forum d’histoire orale 33(2013), 1–15. Working Lives special issue.

verification.note: Fresh selected publisher PDF pp 1–3 and 7–10; printed 8 visually collated. Explicit Portelli guide statement and n 27,p 8 identify his 1991 essay. The article footer repeatedly identifies volume 33(2013); the URL’s 20121210 string and later citations giving 2010 are not substituted for that publication year. A related 2014 reader chapter was a discovery lead, not silently treated as this exact version. Complete article and complete cited books not claimed read.

sources.title: Adelisa Malena, “The sound of silence: Spunti per un dialogo attraverso i secoli” (2016 issue).
sources.citation: Adelisa Malena, “The sound of silence: Spunti per un dialogo attraverso i secoli,” Archivio trentino 1(2016): 161–188, esp.176 and n 54. Issue colophon records printing in January 2017.

verification.note: Fresh selected institutional scan: title 161, discussion 175–176 and bibliography 183–184; printed 176 visually collated. Malena explicitly reproduces Casellato 2014,p 270 quoting Portelli’s 1987 conversation with Cesare Bermani and Liliana Lanzardo, Le provocazioni della storia orale, Primo maggio 27–28:23–27, specifically 24. This mediated recollection supports the narrow Ginzburg criticism. Original 1987 conversation,  Casellato’s complete 2014 essay and the manuscript were not read here. The issue’s 2016 designation and January 2017 printing are distinct.
